question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Inflamous"** is incorrectly spelt. The correct spelling should be **"Infamous"**.
 
• **"Infamous" **refers to being known for a bad reputation or notorious acts. (कुख्यात)
 
 
• **Example: **The dictator was infamous for his brutal regime.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Arrangement** (व्यवस्था): The action, process, or result of arranging or being arranged.

 
 
• **Example:** The **arrangement **of the furniture in the room was perfect for the event.
 
 
 
• **Kerbstone** (कर्बस्टोन): A stone or concrete edging to a pavement or raised path.
 
 
• **Example:** The **kerbstone **was newly installed along the sidewalk.
 
 
 
• **Subjugator** (विजेता): One who brings under control or conquers.
 
 
• **Example:** The **subjugator **enforced strict rules on the newly conquered territory.
